mechanism_evidence.trigger: Construct two columns with one float formatter and render data.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: The rewrite writes raw kwargs to underscored attributes rather than using the property setter that expands field configuration.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Restore constructor-to-setter propagation before the renderer consumes the per-field formatter mapping.

discriminating_observation.description:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b'],float_format='.2');t.add_row([1.234,2.345]);value=t.get_string()
print('constructor_formatter_channels',t.float_format,value)
assert t.float_format=={'a':'.2','b':'.2'} and '1.23' in value and '2.35' in value
